extraction_text: After performing water rituals for fallen friends, the Pandavas, Vidura, Dhritarashtra, and Bharata women live outside the city for a month of purification.
King Yudhishthira completes water rituals, and sages including Vyasa, Narada, Devala, Devasthana, Kanva, and their students visit him.
Narada and sages console King Yudhishthira, praising his conquest of the earth through strength and Krishna's grace.
King Yudhishthira expresses grief over the deaths of Abhimanyu, Draupadi's sons, and other relatives due to greed.
King Yudhishthira reveals Karna's true identity as Kunti's eldest son and their half-brother, previously concealed by Kunti.

attributes.details: Karna is son of Surya, abandoned in river, raised as charioteer's son by Radha

attributes.relationship_change: Revelation of fraternal bond after death

extraction_text: Kunti approached Karna before the war, revealed she was his mother, and urged him to reconcile with his Pandava brothers.

attributes.action: Mother revealing identity and seeking reconciliation

extraction_text: Karna refused to abandon Duryodhana, stating it would be dishonorable, but promised not to kill his four Pandava brothers (excluding Arjuna).

Yudhishthira questions why Karna's chariot wheel was swallowed by earth and why he was cursed, seeking the full truth from the sage.
Narada narrates the story of Karna's curses to the listener.
